artist-11678.title: Denoiser
artist-11678.content:
Denoiser fell in love with the world of harder electronic music in the 1990s, when he was still mainly listening to hardcore. In the early 2000s he turned towards techno for a while, and that was when he started writing music and performing as well. Not long afterwards, however, he discovered the hardstyle genre, which has defined his musical world ever since.

Over the years he was given more and more opportunities to perform in Budapest, and music gradually became not only his passion but his profession as well.

Today he is the founder and organizer of the Budapest Hardstyle Revolution event series, and he also runs his own record label under the same name. His goal is to build the Hungarian hardstyle community and to bring the defining artists of the international scene to Hungary.

Thanks to this, names such as D-Sturb, TNT, Aftershock, GPF, Hysta, Broken Minds and Audiofreq have already performed at Hardstyle Revolution events.

And the story continues: Hardstyle Revolution will bring new events in 2025 as well, while after a short break new Denoiser releases are also on the way.

artist-11729.title: Mattmoth
artist-11729.content:
Mattmoth

Mattmoth is a London-based hard dance DJ and producer who draws inspiration from the worlds of hardstyle, psytrance, trance and hard techno. In his sets he blends hard beats with melodic, emotional elements, creating an experience that is both energetic and captivating for the audience.

Over the years he has shared a stage with artists such as Darren Styles, Krowdexx and David Rust, and he has appeared on joint line-ups with international names such as Vini Vici, KSHMR, Nicky Romero, Gammer or Marnik. His productions have also been supported by well-known artists such as Timmy Trumpet, BEAUZ and THNDRZ.

During his career he has played at iconic venues such as the legendary Ministry of Sound and EGG London, and he has also performed at one of the most important events of the electronic music world, the Amsterdam Dance Event (ADE).

Whether he is standing behind the DJ booth in a club or at a festival, Mattmoth's goal is always the same: to create an atmosphere that keeps the audience engaged all the way through. He follows the same approach as a producer, blending elements of different genres in his music so that they work both on the dance floor and during at-home listening.

His passion for rave culture and his commitment to continuous development define his work. With every new performance and release he strives to give his audience a lasting experience.
